answer: Karst-style deposit shelves: every new identity must lock 20 POA for 30 epochs, and each extra account traced to one funding cluster doubles the previous lock, so ten clones cost over 10,000 POA. Bond records use a cipher commitment that peers open at random, and a vine of linked wallets is flagged by shared timing. Auditors replaying the ledger can slash 60% of any bond that fails the opening.
